items.title: Anthropic expands to India with Bengaluru office
items.summary: Anthropic will open a Bengaluru office in early 2026, its second APAC location, and improve Claude's support for major Indic languages.

items.title: Rahul Patil joins as Chief Technology Officer
items.summary: Rahul Patil brings 20+ years of infrastructure experience from Stripe, AWS, Microsoft, and Oracle Cloud to lead engineering at Anthropic.
